evidence.title: Pennsylvania commissioner accuses Shapiro of 'deceptive' measles death framing as RFK Jr blasts Dem governor

occurrences.checkable_against: Josh Shapiro press conference transcript and Pennsylvania Department of Health announcement
occurrences.quote_span: During a news conference Tuesday alongside Dr. Debra Bogen at Penn Medicine Lancaster General Health Hospital, Shapiro announced the deaths of two people who were unvaccinated for measles.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Lancaster County Coroner death-report records

figure.unit: reported measles deaths or measles-associated deaths

occurrences.quote_span: The coroner reported that they don't have … they had zero measles deaths or measles-associated deaths reported.
occurrences.speaker: Joshua Parsons
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s X post dated August 26, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: "Governor Shapiro's unseemly rush to Lancaster County to convene a national press conference and his giddy delight in announcing two measles deaths was a morose commentary on the contemporary political dialogue," Kennedy wrote in a post on X Wednesday.
occurrences.speaker: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Lancaster County coroner correspondence and case records
occurrences.quote_span: He also said he has received no information about the second person mentioned by Shapiro and the Pennsylvania Department of Health.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania governor's August 25, 2026 press conference transcript
occurrences.quote_span: "I want to be clear: This illness and death from measles is completely preventable," he said.
occurrences.speaker: Josh Shapiro
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Lancaster County coroner and pathology examination records
occurrences.quote_span: The coroner did acknowledge the presence of measles in the infant who died but said neither he nor the pathologist who examined the infant believed measles to be the cause of death.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania Department of Health statement and Pennsylvania statutes
occurrences.quote_span: The Health Department put out a statement in reply to some of these questions. And I think it just raised more questions, but one line they had in there was that not all deaths in Pennsylvania have to be reported to the county coroner, and that's true.
occurrences.speaker: Joshua Parsons
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s X post and Lancaster County coroner records
occurrences.quote_span: "The announcement appears to have been premature, and the deaths may even have been altogether fabricated by one of the Governor's hopeful staffers. The Lancaster County Coroner says that it has no record of any measles deaths. State law requires that all measles deaths be reported to the coroner," Kennedy added.
occurrences.speaker: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania governor's August 25, 2026 press conference transcript and state death records
occurrences.quote_span: “Today, we see the consequences of a lack of immunizations in the first measles-associated deaths that our commonwealth has seen in 35 years,” Shapiro said.
occurrences.speaker: Josh Shapiro
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: The New York Times article archive and headline
occurrences.quote_span: The New York Times, in a story Tuesday still posted to its website, added the headline , "Two Unvaccinated People Died From Measles in Pennsylvania, Officials Say."
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News Digital interview record and New York Times statement
occurrences.quote_span: Reached by Fox News Digital, a representative from the Times said the newspaper is "confident in the accuracy of our story."
occurrences.speaker: The New York Times representative
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania Statutes Title 16 and county coroner reporting records
occurrences.quote_span: But if you have someone who dies of an infectious disease, that does have to be reported.
occurrences.speaker: Joshua Parsons
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania measles-related deaths
